sections.markdown:
## D — Seat adjustment and occupant protection
Each knowledge sentence carries one physical-page anchor and one fact identifier. The author completed a separate source-fidelity pass before submission; independent coverage and hallucination QA remain pending.
Scope exclusions and source issues: Read physical pages twenty-nine and thirty as ordinary occupant-protection guidance. The age-and-weight trigger for mandatory child seats is not resolved from the two inconsistent sentences. Quantitative crash analogies and unsourced medical timing claims are not promoted to learner facts.
Dynamic disposition: The child-restraint age-and-weight threshold is withheld because the page uses conflicting formulations; current monetary penalties and quantitative crash analogies also remain debt.
Text-only extraction cannot establish the meaning of an unreadable diagram. Any such material is withheld until a page-specific visual observation is recorded.

corpus_stability.reason: This is a bounded snapshot of the issuer-linked Montana handbook. Its revision conflict is explicitly held as debt; there is no evidence in the supplied source of multiple substantive rewrites per year. Currency of individual changeable provisions is not inferred from this assessment.

verification_debt.claim_text: Page thirty says a child six years old and weighing less than sixty pounds in one paragraph, then up to age six and sixty pounds in another. Mandatory age/weight boundaries and combination need issuer clarification; no numeric child-seat trigger is asserted.
Page twenty-nine gives a monetary seatbelt penalty; verify current official penalty before asserting an amount.

Page twenty-nine crash-speed, building-height and elephant analogy and page thirty adult-to-crash-force calculation lack traceable calculation context. Quantitative illustrations are withheld pending official evidence.
Page twenty-nine first-hour care statement has no cited medical study. No clinical timing rule or survival prediction is asserted.
